crypto_spot.source: CoinDCX spot base tier (secondary sources, Oct 2026); excludes 1% TDS

execution: A decision at a bar's close acts at the next bar's open, as a market order.
A protective stop triggers on a touch and fills at the open on a gap.
A target is a resting order and fills only when the market trades through it.
When one bar reaches both stop and target, the stop is taken.
One position per market at a time; a signal that arrives during one is not taken.
A position open at the end of a window is closed at that window's last close.
Signals are computed on the spot book's bars; the perpetual profile assumes the perpetual tracks them — basis is not modelled.
No partial fills, no latency beyond the one-bar delay, no market impact: sizes are assumed small against the book.
